story.title: NASSCOM Chair: AI Will Accelerate India's Tech Industry, Not Replace Its Workforce
story.summary: Newly appointed NASSCOM Chairman Srikanth Velamakanni has stated publicly that AI will act as an accelerator for India's technology sector rather than a threat to employment, affirming that the tech industry will continue hiring people. His remarks come at a critical juncture as India's IT sector faces twin pressures of geopolitical uncertainty and rapid AI-driven disruption. NASSCOM represents hundreds of Indian IT firms employing millions of workers, giving this leadership position significant weight in shaping industry and government narratives around AI and jobs.
